questions.cardDe: Wie heißt der Film, bei dessen Dreharbeiten 1974 Steven Spielberg den dauerkritischen Autor der Romanvorlage zur Weißglut trieb?
questions.de: Wie heißt der Film, bei dessen Dreharbeiten 1974 Steven Spielberg den dauerkritischen Autor der Romanvorlage zur Weißglut trieb?
questions.en: What is the film during whose shooting in 1974 Steven Spielberg drove the constantly critical author of the source novel up the wall?

timeline.labelEn: Steven Spielberg's Jaws, based on Peter Benchley's novel, released
timeline.labelDe: Steven Spielbergs „Der weiße Hai“ nach Peter Benchleys Roman kommt in die Kinos

questions.notes: Shot in 1974 from Peter Benchley's 1974 novel; Spielberg discarded Benchley's subplots and had the script rewritten by Carl Gottlieb.

questions.en: Which country had a 10 percent electoral threshold for parliamentary elections until 2022, which the Council of Europe criticised as too high in 2004?

timeline.labelEn: Turkey lowers its parliamentary electoral threshold from 10 % to 7 %
timeline.labelDe: Die Türkei senkt ihre Sperrklausel bei Parlamentswahlen von 10 % auf 7 %

questions.notes: Dated premise: since 31 March 2022 Turkey's threshold is 7 %, below Liechtenstein's 8 %; the reworked question asks about the 10 % era.
